title: Entralink records
description: The Entralink roguelike's records (docs/paperwhite2/design/entralink-roguelike-prototype.md, "Records"; tools/paperwhite2/entralink_records.py). The Nightmare codex records every species with "pokedex": false (the forest's Nightmares, in every form) and the special forms listed here, which the records also show in a list of their own.

black_ranks.description: The Entree's Black Tree ranks: the Dream Shards earned in all (whatever was spent) that reach ranks 1 to 5, each above the one before

white_milestones.description: The milestones that count for the Entree's White Tree rank, each reached raising it by one in any order: beat_final (the final room beaten, Darkrai), catch_all (every catchable enemy of the rooms caught), fill_codex (every Nightmare species and special form met), shop_cap (the hub shop's picks bought up to its cap), all_rooms (every room of rooms/ entered)

special_forms.description: The forest-only forms counted as Special: a species and one of its forms, each met, beaten and caught counted alone

form.description: Its form, below the species' form count
